### [Introducing Claude 4](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-4)

**Anthropic** · 2026-11-12

Anthropic introduced Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4, featuring hybrid execution modes with near-instant responses and extended thinking, alongside top-tier coding performance.

- Claude Opus 4 achieved benchmark scores of 72.5% on SWE-bench and 43.2% on Terminal-bench, demonstrating continuous performance on multi-hour tasks.
- Claude Sonnet 4 scored a state-of-the-art 72.7% on SWE-bench and reduced codebase navigation errors from 20% to near zero in third-party testing.
- Both releases are hybrid models offering near-instant responses and extended thinking modes across API, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
- API pricing remains fixed at $15/$75 per million tokens for Opus 4 and $3/$15 per million tokens for Sonnet 4.

**Why it matters:** These updates significantly expand the capabilities of autonomous AI coding agents, allowing them to perform complex multi-hour codebase refactoring and precise multi-file edits.

### [llm-gemini 0.37](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/12/llm-gemini/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-11-12

llm-gemini 0.37 updates support for Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model alongside existing Carbon and Argon variants.

- Gemini 4 Hydrogen costs $1.50/M input, $0.075/M cached input, and $7.50/M output tokens.
- Carbon and Argon both cost $2.00/$0.10/$10.00 until Nov 30, 2026, doubling to $4.00/$0.20/$20.00 on Dec 1, 2026.
- Argon uses fewer tokens per turn for faster responses compared to Carbon at identical token-pricing tiers.
- Hydrogen serves as Google's new free tier model, powers Google Search AI features, and targets everyday software development tasks.

**Why it matters:** Hydrogen offers a lower-cost option within the Gemini 4 family, though its $1.50/$7.50 pricing remains 15x higher than competitors like Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna.

`llm` `gemini` `google` `ai-pricing`
